author: igv4321
body:
This is a bug fix taking care of a feature not properly addressed in the PR #49556. The updated code now normalizes time-shifted Hcal pulse shapes on the fly, even if large time shifts result in the leading or trailing part of the pulse truncated.

Normal matrix tests were run.

In addition to normal matrix tests, some private validation was performed in which the pulse shapes were written into a private database, and that database was used for Hcal rechit reconstruction.

This fix will need to be backported to 17_0 for potential Run 3 rereco scenarios.
title: Normalizing time-shifted Hcal pulse shapes
